prompt: How many orders did Voltmarkt take in each ISO week from Monday 2024-12-16 to Sunday 2025-01-12? Use the orders table. order_ts holds the time of the order in UTC, so work in UTC and keep the orders from 2024-12-16 00:00 up to but not including 2025-01-13 00:00. Return three columns, in this order: iso_year, the year the ISO week belongs to, iso_week, the ISO week number, and orders, the number of orders. Return one row for each ISO week. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the calculated columns: the ISO year and the ISO week number of each order, and the count.
ISO week 1 of 2025 starts on Monday 2024-12-30, so year() would put 30 and 31 December in the wrong year. isoyear gives the year the week belongs to, and week gives its ISO number.
faded_suffix:
FROM orders
WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-12-16 00:00:00'
  AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-13 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1, 2
why_this_works: isoyear and week label each order with the ISO week it falls in, so 30 and 31 December 2024 join week 1 of 2025 instead of forming a week 1 of 2024.
